title.narrative: Emergency Response: New Post-War Opportunities to Advance the Two-State Solution

description.narrative: The action aims at contributing to the concretisation of support for the two-state solution, through the combined efforts of the Two-State Coalition. Specifically, it aims at creating 1) an enhanced awareness and support among Israeli, Palestinian and international key stakeholders for the urgency of a two-state solution, and 2) an enhanced awareness of Israeli and Palestinian public about a about a two-solution as only viable path out of violence towards a secure, just future for both people.
